description: Convert field data types in data streams (e.g., string to integer, integer to float)

type_conversions.info: Configure field type conversion rules. Click 'Load Fields' to automatically analyze upstream fields.

field_name.info: The name of the field to convert

source_type.info: Detected data type of the field

target_type.info: Select the target data type to convert to

conversion_rule.info:
Type-specific rules (optional):
• datetime: Format string (yyyy-MM-dd, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, ISO8601, etc.)
• boolean: Comma-separated true values (e.g., true,1,yes)
• integer/float: Leave empty for default conversion
• string: Leave empty

pass_through_unmapped.info: Pass through fields not configured for conversion (default: true)

strict_validation.info: Fail on conversion errors. If disabled, keeps original value on error (default: true)

warnings.parse_failure: May fail to parse non-numeric strings
